notes.title: Lingotopia 1.1 is out now
notes.content:
Lingotopia 1.1 is out now! 

To celebrate the release Lingotopia is also 17% off for one week!

This is a free update for those of you who own the game already and includes many new features, languages and bug fixes. Here are some of the changes:

[list]
[*]Multiple save games allow you to learn more than one language at a time. 
[*]There are many new words to discover by exploring the city. Some of them will be available on your first play-through, however, some of them will only be visible after beating the game and starting again with your existing vocabulary.
[*]There is more cause and affect for your actions. You'll also be notified when your answer to a question changes the game's story. 
[*]New languages! You can now learn Arabic by playing the game! There are also many more community translations. Tlingit, for example, is an endangered language spoken in the USA and Canada.
[/list]

I'm going to continue to support Lingotopia by working on bug fixes and perhaps also some new features. But will now devote most of my time and attention towards my next language learning game. It's a smaller project that should be done by early next year.

Kind regards,

Tristan

notes.title: Lingotopia 1.03 P1 - Bugfixes
notes.content:
​Hello!

A new update with several bug fixes is live.

[list][*]Turkish special characters are now rendered properly.
[*]Player was able to jump on top of objects like the market stall.
[*]No longer are the red words to learn made bold when learning Japanese and Chinese in their native scripts. More complex characters became difficult to read.
[*]It was not possible to learn the word for piano, guitar and drums.
[*]Player speed no longer depends on performance.
[*]When talking to people, two of the three options to click on were sometimes the same word.
[*]When talking to people, sometimes one of the options could be the word "don" or "t" (the game was actually splitting the word "don't".
[*]Voice recording volume has been levelled further.
[/list]

In addition to this, I have further improved the camera, so that it's easier to make small adjustments.

I'm now going to begin working on some exciting new features, you'll hear from me again soon.
Sincerely,

Tristan

notes.title: Lingotopia 1.02
notes.content:
​Hello everyone!

Lingotopia has just been updated with some minor fixes and major changes to the way the camera works.

The camera is still a work in progress and more improvements are incoming, but you can now rotate the camera by moving the mouse to the edge of the screen and not by clicking and dragging. You can also rotate the camera while walking.

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*]You may have seen the guide walk on water or jump up rocks, essentially taking illegal shortcuts to get places. This no longer happens.
[*]The player no longer just stops when you walk into an object, you now "glide" off of objects in the environment.
[*]Levelled Japanese audio so all characters talk at the same volume.
[/list]
I will update the game again in a few days with more bugfixes, more changes to the camera and with drastic changes to the player character controls​.

Sincerely,

Tristan

notes.title: Another round of bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The second patch is now live. It contains several bugfixes.
[list]
    [*] No longer will words you don't know be marked purple and translate as "ERROR" when learning Japanese.
    [*]Lithuanian font had missing characters.
    [*]Walking citizens speech bubbles display a little longer.
    [*]Sound volume slider now affects audio recording volume as well.
    [*]Player collider is smaller so you should no longer get stuck as easily.
[/list]

There'll be more bug fixes coming this weekend, then I'll have another look at the player movement and do everything I can do to make the player control better.

Sincerely,

Tristan

notes.title: Lingotopia 1.01 is out now
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I just uploaded a new build that should fix some issues you may have run into.

[list]
    [*]Fixes several bugs, most notably you should no longer be able to get stuck while speaking to characters in Japanese
    [*]Esperanto and Norwegian both had missing characters in the font.
    [*]Items in dictionary should no longer overlap
    [*]Japanese dictionary no longer displays particles as "NT(topic marker)", but as "topic marker".
    [*]When learning the word for boat, the boat will stop moving. I always thought it looked kind of cool if it sailed off screen, but this should be clearer.
[/list]

I'm sorry for all the bugs you've run into and will continue to update the game on a daily (or near daily) basis until the game is as polished as it should have been on day one.
